label: Self-dependence for its being makes depending two-way on an inhabited domain
meaning: If D is reflexive, any single being b gives D b b twice over, so the unrestricted asymmetry of STMT-DEPENDENCE-FOR-BEING-ASYMMETRIC fails on every inhabited domain. This makes the reading conflict of #1593 exact: the unrestricted premise is available only on a strict, non-reflexive reading of DependsForBeing. It does not refute STMT-DEPENDENCE-FOR-BEING-ASYMMETRIC outright, since reflexivity is itself an open premise.
